    mean_with = np.mean(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    mean_call = np.mean(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    mean_no = np.mean(logp_no_call, axis=1)

action.new_text:
# Compute per-candidate total losses (negative log probability sum)
    loss_with = -np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call = -np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no = -np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Paper condition: keep if API gives lower loss than call-only and lower than no-call within slack
    keep = (loss_with < loss_call) & (loss_with < loss_no + tau_filter)
    margins = loss_no - loss_with
    return keep, margins
